bio: A plush house in the centre of the village, a glass-paned wine cellar, a bar with an Art Deco look, a chic and inviting dining room: welcome to Olivier Leflaive's place! The famous Côte de Beaune winegrower has created two eateries. Le Bistro d'Olivier offers a seasonal menu inspired by local produce, and the restaurant Klima has more fine dining ambitions. Great wine list, needless to say, thanks to the estate's 80 appellations....
